systems.owner: Ministries of Education at federal and state levels
systems.tiers: Federal and state ministries; the document names it only as the vehicle for school censuses

note: The statistics strategy (September 2012) names EMIS once, as the system under which the education ministries undertake school censuses: class census, so no fact. It also says no operational databases exist at ministries and states and that management information systems are weak across them, without naming schools.
